games_collected_definition: Unique completed matchups represented by usable Division I team box scores; each game counted once

overall_model.inseason_scaling: 0–100 percentile across played teams with finite net ratings; average ties; one rated team = 50
overall_model.missing_net: Keep preseason ordering inputs until usable net rating is available

clutch_definition: Margin <= 3 at any point with 3:00 or less in regulation second half; overtime qualifies
clutch_incomplete_coverage: Unavailable until all completed team games are classified
sos_snapshot_rule: Before each Eastern-calendar day; only earlier completed games
adjusted_efficiency_model: OFred additive, D1-only, equal game weights, one baseline pseudo-game
ofs_model: ofs-v1: net component anchored so sixth-highest net team totals 25 percentage points; ceiling 75
ofs_rank_ties: Average ranks; ranks scaled among teams with finite values for each metric
ofs_missing_inputs: No final OFS without all three inputs and the reference team's SOS and CLUTCH
ofs_probability_status: Heuristic percentage index; not empirically calibrated as a championship probability
